name: Employer-Sponsored Work Visa

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must act as legal sponsor and hold a corporate work license before a foreign employee's work visa (the 'Is'/employment e-visa category) can be issued. The visa is tied directly to the sponsoring company -- the employee cannot work elsewhere on it. Applications must be initiated from outside Uzbekistan.
requirements.fix_path: Have the employer obtain the corporate work license and initiate the visa application from abroad.

requirements.blocker_text: A labor market test requires the employer to show no suitable local candidate exists for the role before sponsoring a foreign worker.
requirements.fix_path: Employer must document the absence of a qualified local candidate.

sources.title: Rivermate (private EOR/HR-guide site) -- employer-sponsored work visa process, corporate work license requirement, labor market test, and the visa's employer-tied restriction
